0|d54730b50bae1f3119bd686d551d66f0fcc387ca|torvalds~linux|/home/usuario01/Titan-Files-Research/src/_00/output/C/torvalds~linux|False|"bpf: Introduce opaque bpf_refcount struct and add btf_record plumbing
A 'struct bpf_refcount' is added to the set of opaque uapi/bpf.h types
meant for use in BPF programs. Similarly to other opaque types like
bpf_spin_lock and bpf_rbtree_node
column2: the verifier needs to know where in

column1: user-defined struct types a bpf_refcount can be located
btf_record plumbing is added to enable this. bpf_refcount is sized to
hold a refcount_t.
Similarly to bpf_spin_lock
column2: the offset of a bpf_refcount is cached in

column1: btf_record as refcount_off in addition to being in the field array.
Caching refcount_off makes sense for this field because further patches
in the series will modify functions that take local kptrs (e.g.
bpf_obj_drop) to change their behavior if the type they're operating on
is refcounted. So enabling fast ""is this type refcounted?"" checks is
desirable.
No such verifier behavior changes are introduced in this patch
logic to recognize 'struct bpf_refcount' in btf_record.
